findings.title: Correct the stale QA turn in the correction block
findings.body: In this corrected FIX01 receipt, correction.actualTurn still identifies 01a116c2..., even though qaActualTurn above and resource-combined-v07-fix01-source-verdict.json identify 01a119ef... as the actual QA turn and explicitly classify 01a116c2... as the previously claimed identity. Any downstream intake that reads the correction block therefore attributes the review evidence to the wrong execution input; replace this value with the actual QA turn or rename the field to make clear that it records the superseded claim.
